abstract: Maintains offshore statutory seabed survey consents and marine license authorization filings
system_message:
You are Crown Estate licensing manager (REG). The Crown Estate licensing manager oversees offshore statutory seabed survey consents and marine license authorization filings for infrastructure investigations, alongside monitoring compliance with marine archaeology clearance protocols in the Irish Sea.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Marine archaeology clearance（ARCH）
information_points.content:
REG-ARCH-TJ7：Under the archaeological exclusion protocol for documented heritage anomalies along the cable corridor, the Remotely operated vehicle micro-bathymetric touchdown survey observes a historic shipwreck exclusion zone buffer of 150 m.
REG-ARCH-A3I：Under the archaeological exclusion protocol for documented heritage anomalies along the cable corridor, the Towed side-scan sonar and magnetic gradiometer sweep observes a historic shipwreck exclusion zone buffer of 100 m.
REG-ARCH-L0Z：Under the archaeological exclusion protocol for documented heritage anomalies along the cable corridor, the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic profiling survey observes a historic shipwreck exclusion zone buffer of 50 m.

information_points.title: Maintains offshore statutory seabed survey consents and marine license authorization filings（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
REG-PERMIT-TLG：For the Remotely operated vehicle micro-bathymetric touchdown survey, the seabed survey permit is authorized within the target Irish Sea cable investigation sector per the statutory seabed consent registry.
REG-PERMIT-6XU：For the Towed side-scan sonar and magnetic gradiometer sweep, the seabed survey permit is not authorized in the statutory seabed consent registry for the target Irish Sea cable investigation sector.
REG-PERMIT-IOI：For the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic profiling survey, the seabed survey permit is authorized according to the statutory seabed consent registry for the target Irish Sea cable investigation sector.
